result.summary: The page renders largely as expected with a clean layout. Found 1 minor styling inconsistency.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon buttons on the restaurant cards use inconsistent styling: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white circular background with a dark heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button background and icon color across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
